subject: Business Models
title: Data Monetization
description: A short lesson to help you apply Data Monetization.

hook.text: Google's search is free. Its real product is your data, sold to advertisers at $280 billion/year.

buildup.text: Every search, click, and location ping builds a profile. Advertisers bid to reach specific profiles.

discovery.text: The average American's data is worth about $240/year to advertisers. In aggregate, trillions.

twist.text: Privacy laws like GDPR are restricting data collection. Apple's tracking opt-out cost Meta $10 billion.

climax.text: Data monetization built the biggest companies in history, but regulation is reshaping it.

punchline.text: Your clicks are the product. Data is the real currency.

quiz.question: How much did Apple's privacy changes cost Meta?
